description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::ProjectImporter' class, which contains business logic for importing project data from one project to another, including property definitions, dependency management, and data transfer methods.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::ProjectImporter
classes.description: A class encapsulating the logic for importing project data, managing properties, dependencies, and data transfer between projects.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Returns a deep clone of the list of public properties available for import.

methods.name: importable_properties
methods.description: Returns a list of properties that can be imported into a project based on its inventory.

methods.name: unimportable_properties
methods.description: Returns a list of properties that cannot be imported into a project based on its inventory.

methods.name: _importable_properties
methods.description: Internal method that determines importable or unimportable properties based on inventory and dependencies.

methods.name: can_import_properties
methods.description: Checks if a set of properties can be imported into a project, validating their existence and importability.

methods.name: import_data
methods.description: Performs the import of specified properties from a source project to a target project, handling dependencies and data transfer.

methods.name: _validate_properties
methods.description: Validates that the list of property keys is valid and that dependencies are satisfied.
